law: Merchants aren’t required to set up an Apple Developer account or configure their own keys and certificates — you set up a shared set of keys and certificates for your entire merchant portfolio.
To use this API in the sandbox environment, call the endpoints using the domain .
To use the Apple Pay Web Merchant Registration API, you must meet the following requirements: Your organization must be enrolled in the Apple Developer program.
You must apply for access to the API.
Your server must call the API using mutual authentication with Transport Layer Security (TLS) 1.2 or later, and one of the supported cipher suites.
